_comment: Demonstrates the `video` scene with an rrweb SOURCE (a captured DOM session, not an MP4). examples/demos/sample-tour.rrweb.json was produced by `slidey capture <tour.json> out.rrweb.json` (real-time rrweb recording of a tour). Baked output (mp4/pdf/png) seek-rasterizes the log via rrweb's Replayer; the interactive web viewer mounts a live, scrubbable, chapter-aware RrwebPlayer. Chapters come from in-log slidey.chapter custom events. Render: PUPPETEER_EXECUTABLE_PATH=... slidey examples/rrweb-demo.json out.mp4  (or .pdf / a dir for PNG posters).
